hero.subtitle: When a death in Mount Shasta was caused by someone else's negligence, the people left behind have rights under California law. LawProactive quietly connects Siskiyou County families with an independent wrongful death attorney, for free.

about.title: Mount Shasta Wrongful Death Claims
about.longDescription: Mount Shasta is a town of roughly 3,300 people, and when someone here dies because of another person's carelessness, the loss is felt by neighbors, coworkers and the families who gather along N Mt Shasta Boulevard. The public record for 2025 shows four injury collisions and no traffic deaths inside city limits, but fatal harm does not come only from the road. A fall on poorly maintained property, a medical error, a defective product or a collision on the Interstate 5 grades north or south of town can each become the basis for a California wrongful death claim. That claim belongs first to a surviving spouse or domestic partner and children, and it generally must be filed within two years of the date of death. LawProactive is not a law firm. We are a free service that listens to what happened and connects you with an independent attorney who handles Siskiyou County wrongful death matters on contingency, so nothing is owed unless there is a recovery. You set the pace. We simply make the first conversation less lonely.

whyChoose.title: Why Mount Shasta Families Reach Out to LawProactive

items.title: Clarity on who can file
items.desc: California limits wrongful death standing to a surviving spouse or domestic partner and children first, then certain dependents and heirs. The attorney you're connected with can explain where you stand before anything is filed.

items.title: Deadlines handled carefully
items.desc: Most claims must be brought within two years of the date of death, and the window is shorter when a city, county or state agency is involved. Early contact protects your family's options.

items.title: A civil path, independent of any criminal case
items.desc: A wrongful death action is separate from whatever the district attorney may or may not pursue. Recoverable losses can include funeral and burial costs, lost financial support, and the loss of love, companionship and guidance.

items.question: The crash happened on I-5 just outside Mount Shasta, not in town. Does that change anything?
items.answer: Not in a way that should worry you. Interstate 5 is the highest-volume corridor in the public collision record for this area, and a fatal collision on the northbound or southbound lanes can still support a California wrongful death claim. Where the case is filed and which agencies investigated are details an attorney sorts out with you; the two-year deadline still runs from the date of death.

items.question: Does LawProactive charge anything, and do you represent us?
items.answer: We charge nothing and we are not a law firm. Our role is to hear what happened and connect you with an independent attorney who handles wrongful death claims in Siskiyou County. Those attorneys work on contingency, which means no attorney fee unless there is a recovery.

items.question: Can we still bring a claim if no one was criminally charged?
items.answer: Yes. A wrongful death claim is a civil action with a different standard of proof than a criminal prosecution, so the absence of charges does not close the door. Families can seek compensation for funeral expenses, the financial support the person would have provided, and the loss of their love, companionship and guidance. An attorney can look at the facts even where law enforcement did not pursue a case.
